html:
Amy is in her fourth year studying a Bachelor of Laws at the University of Notre Dame. Amy has always had a desire to become a Family Lawyer.

Amy’s passion for family law stems from an ambition to provide clients comfort and support through the separation process. Amy is driven by being able to reassure and guide clients through their difficult family circumstances.
